name: regsentry
description: Inspect static tracking signals on an authorized public website, observe bounded browser behavior before consent and after supported reject-all or accept-all controls, compare dated observations, and export a plain-text evidence report. Incomplete phases stay unresolved. Results describe observed request attempts and supplied evidence, not legal compliance or proof that a fix is complete.
